description: rate_limiter.rs uses a hard cap of 65,536 tracked IPs with immediate eviction on breach. Without a hard cap an adversary sending requests from many distinct IPs could grow the HashMap unboundedly. The periodic eviction every 1024 calls amortizes O(n) cost. The call_count starts at 1 so the first call does not trigger a scan over an empty map. This is the correct design for a token-bucket rate limiter under adversarial conditions.
title: DECISION: rate limiter MAX_ENTRIES hard cap with immediate eviction is correct DDoS defence
